title: E0061: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
plain_english: This rule reports output of user-controlled data to HTML without appropriate escaping. If an attacker can inject markup or script content, it may execute in another user's browser.
why_matters: XSS can expose session data, perform actions as the affected user, redirect users, or modify page content.
what_it_checks: Cases where user-controlled input reaches HTML output, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
